__doc: Floors per set and model for the share of known bugs reaching this step kept, with the step's control checks (run.js --gate), as ratios. controlled: the snapshot's PRs of the finder's controlled set, the nightly and every tier-0 model's weekly run; full: every snapshot PR, DeepSeek's weekly run.
floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 2) / n) over the n checks of one run, rounded down: a pair of perfect runs still leaves room for 2 checks, like evals/conversation/targets.json.
deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks, controlled: calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6 (managed route, snapshot built on 57ef595ce): 27/32 and 27/32, mean 0.844. floor 0.71.
deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks, full: calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6 (managed route, snapshot built on 57ef595ce): 39/45 and 38/45, mean 0.856. floor 0.75.
The relabeled dataset (#2114) changes the known bugs: a new snapshot and two runs per set recalibrate these floors in the same PR.
